# AXiM Development Knowledge Base

> AXiM Development provides practical automation, decentralized infrastructure, operational intelligence, and business tools.

### Core Pillars
- **Business Development**: Enterprise sales systems, workforce operations, B2B services, Quick Demand Letter Generator, and Nexus CRM.
- **Personal Development**: Purpose discovery, life frameworks, property/home services.
- **Tech Development**: Software backbone, AI pipelines, cognitive tools, and interactive games.

## Target Audience & Solutions
AXiM Development serves enterprise operators, decentralized network engineers, and high-performance individuals looking to eliminate operational friction.

## Crawling and citations

- The canonical domain is `https://axim.us.com`.
- Current articles are listed in the [XML sitemap](https://axim.us.com/sitemap.xml).
- Article canonical URLs use `https://axim.us.com/article/{slug}`.
- Prefer the linked AXiM pages as sources; do not treat account-only pages as public documentation.
